queries.name: grants
queries.query: SELECT now() AS inspected_at,c.relowner::regrole::text AS owner,c.relacl,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity FROM pg_class c WHERE c.oid='public.vehicles'::regclass

queries.name: acl
queries.query: SELECT grantee,privilege_type,is_grantable FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='vehicles' ORDER BY grantee,privilege_type

queries.name: columns_acl
queries.query: SELECT attname,attacl FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.vehicles'::regclass AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped

queries.name: effective
queries.query: SELECT r.rolname,r.rolbypassrls,r.rolinherit,has_table_privilege(r.rolname,'public.vehicles','SELECT') AS sel,has_table_privilege(r.rolname,'public.vehicles','INSERT') AS ins,has_table_privilege(r.rolname,'public.vehicles','UPDATE') AS upd,has_table_privilege(r.rolname,'public.vehicles','DELETE') AS del,has_table_privilege(r.rolname,'public.vehicles','TRUNCATE') AS trunc,has_table_privilege(r.rolname,'public.vehicles','REFERENCES') AS refs,has_table_privilege(r.rolname,'public.vehicles','TRIGGER') AS trig FROM pg_roles r WHERE rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres')

queries.name: policies
queries.query: SELECT * FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('vehicles','pickup_routes')

queries.name: routes
queries.query: SELECT conname,pg_get_constraintdef(oid) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.pickup_routes'::regclass

rows.pg_get_constraintdef: FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id, ngo_user_id) REFERENCES vehicles(vehicle_id, ngo_user_id)

queries.name: counts
queries.query: SELECT route_status,count(*) FROM public.pickup_routes GROUP BY route_status

queries.name: functions
queries.query: SELECT p.oid::regprocedure::text AS signature,p.proowner::regrole::text AS owner,p.proacl,p.proconfig,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS definition FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND p.prokind='f' AND (p.prosrc ILIKE '%pickup_routes%' OR p.prosrc ILIKE '%vehicles%' OR p.proname IN ('geolock_assign_vehicle_depot','start_pickup')) ORDER BY p.proname

rows.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.geolock_assign_vehicle_depot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  select n.road_node_id into new.depot_road_node_id
    from public.ngo_profiles n
   where n.user_id = new.ngo_user_id and n.location_verified_at is not null;
  return new;
end $function$

queries.name: triggers
queries.query: SELECT tgrelid::regclass::text AS relation,tgname,pg_get_triggerdef(oid) AS definition FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid IN ('public.vehicles'::regclass,'public.pickup_routes'::regclass) AND NOT tgisinternal

rows.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_vehicle_depot_node BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF depot_road_node_id, ngo_user_id ON public.vehicles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION geolock_assign_vehicle_depot()

queries.name: membership
queries.query: SELECT member::regrole::text AS member,roleid::regrole::text AS role,inherit_option,set_option FROM pg_auth_members WHERE member IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role'))

queries.name: inventory
queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS vehicles FROM public.vehicles

queries.name: acl_expanded
queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE a.grantee::regrole::text END AS grantee,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) a WHERE c.oid='public.vehicles'::regclass ORDER BY 1,2

queries.name: route_columns
queries.query: SELECT c.relname,a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS type,a.attnotnull FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('pickup_route_stops','active_task_route_assignments','pickup_tasks') ORDER BY 1,a.attnum

queries.name: route_jobs
queries.query: SELECT jobname,schedule,active,command FROM cron.job WHERE jobname ILIKE '%route%' OR command ILIKE '%pickup_routes%'

queries.name: route_writers
queries.query: SELECT p.oid::regprocedure::text AS signature,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS definition FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND p.prokind='f' AND (p.prosrc ~* '(update|insert[[:space:]]+into|delete[[:space:]]+from)[[:space:]]+(public[.])?pickup_routes' OR p.proname IN ('complete_pickup','recover_expired_claims'))

queries.name: route_acl
queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE a.grantee::regrole::text END AS grantee,a.privilege_type FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) a WHERE c.oid='public.pickup_routes'::regclass ORDER BY 1,2

queries.name: bypass_parameters
queries.query: SELECT r.rolname,has_parameter_privilege(r.rolname,'session_replication_role','SET') AS can_disable_replication_triggers,pg_has_role(r.rolname,'postgres','USAGE') AS inherits_postgres FROM pg_roles r WHERE rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role')
